title: Yellow Zesty Argentinian Chicken Skewers
description: A light and flavorful Argentinian dish featuring chicken skewers with a zesty Thai chilli jam sauce, made with render fat for a crispy texture, perfect for a low-calorie dinner
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Brush the render fat onto the chicken skewers, making sure they are evenly coated
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through
While the chicken is cooking, heat the Thai chilli jam in a small saucepan over low heat
Once the chicken is done, brush the warmed Thai chilli jam onto the skewers
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
